headline: Epigral Limited: SEBI Takeover Regulation 31(4) Disclosure Filed
sum: Epigral Limited has filed a mandatory disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations Regulation 31(4), triggered by a substantial acquisition of shares in the company. The disclosure, submitted to NSE, marks the public filing of a shareholding event requiring acquirer identification and shareholding structure clarification under takeover code.
detail: Under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations 2011, Regulation 31(4) requires disclosure of shareholding patterns when a person acquires substantial stakes. Epigral's filing to NSE indicates a material shareholding change. The specific identity of the acquirer, stake size, consideration, and whether an open offer is required should be clarified in the detailed disclosure document referenced in the exchange filing.
